layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The emergence of large models, also known as founda-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion models, has brought significant advancements to AI re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: search. One such model is Segment Anything (SAM), which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is designed for image segmentation tasks. However, as with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: other foundation models, our experimental findings suggest

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that SAM may fail or perform poorly in certain segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion tasks, such as shadow detection and camouflaged ob-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ject detection (concealed object detection). This study first

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: paves the way for applying the large pre-trained image seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation model SAM to these downstream tasks, even in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: situations where SAM performs poorly. Rather than fine-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tuning the SAM network, we propose SAM-Adapter, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: incorporates domain-specific information or visual prompts

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: into the segmentation network by using simple yet effective

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adapters. By integrating task-specific knowledge with gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eral knowledge learnt by the large model, SAM-Adapter can

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: significantly elevate the performance of SAM in challeng-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing tasks as shown in extensive experiments. We can even

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: outperform task-specific network models and achieve state-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of-the-art performance in the task we tested: camouflaged

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: object detection, shadow detection. Our code of adapt-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing SAM in downstream applications have been released

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: publicly at https://github.com/tianrun-chen/SAM-Adapter-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: PyTorch/ and has benefited many researchers. We believe

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our work opens up opportunities for utilizing SAM in down-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stream tasks, with potential applications in various felds,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: including medical image processing, agriculture, remote

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sensing, and more.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: AI research has witnessed a paradigm shift with models

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trained on vast amounts of data at scale. These models, or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: known as foundation models, such as BERT, DALL-E, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: GPT-3 have shown promising results in many language or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vision tasks [2]. Recently, among the foundation models,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Segment Anything (SAM) [24] has a distinct position as a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: generic image segmentation model trained on the large vi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sual corpus [24]. It has been demonstrated that SAM has

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: successful segmentation capabilities in diverse scenarios,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which makes it a groundbreaking step toward image seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation and related fields of computer vision.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However, as computer vision encompasses a broad spec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trum of problems, SAM's incompleteness is evident, which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is similar to other foundation models since the training data

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cannot encompass the entire corpus, and working scenarios

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are subject to variation [2]. In this study, we first test SAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in some challenging low-level structural segmentation tasks

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: including camouflaged object detection (concealed scenes)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and shadow detection, and we find that the SAM model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trained on general images cannot perfectly "Segment Any-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thing" in these cases.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: As such, a crucial research problem is: How to harness

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the capabilities acquired by large models from massive cor-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pora and leverage them to benefit downstream tasks?

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Here, we introduce the SAM-Adapter, which serves as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a solution to the research problem mentioned above. To the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: best of our knowledge, this pioneering work has been the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: first attempt to adapt the large pre-trained image segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation model SAM to specific downstream tasks with en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hanced performance. As its name states, SAM-Adapter is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a very simple yet effective adaptation technique that lever-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ages internal knowledge and external control signal. Specif-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Corresponding Author. + Equal Contribution

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ically, it is a lightweight model that can learn alignment with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a relatively small amount of data and serves as an additional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: network to inject task-specific guidance information from

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the samples of that task. Information is conveyed to the net-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work using visual prompts [49, 33], which has been demon-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strated to be efficient and effective in adapting a frozen large

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foundation model to many downstream tasks with a min-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: imum number of additional trainable parameters and less

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fine-tuning time and resource consumption.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Specifically, we show that our method is:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • Generalizable: SAM-Adapter can be directly applied

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to customized datasets of various tasks to enhance per-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formance with the assistance of SAM.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • Composable: It is effortless to combine multiple

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: explicit conditions to fine-tune SAM with multi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: condition control.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • Efficient and Effective: Our method is more time and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: resource-efficient and obtains better result than data-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: driven fine-tuning without the injection of task-specific

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: information, as demonstrated in our ablation experi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ment.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We perform extensive experiments on multiple tasks and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: datasets, including ISTD for shadow detection [47] and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: COD10K [12], CHAMELEON [43], CAMO [27] for cam-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ouflaged object detection task. Benefiting from the capabil-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity of SAM and our SAM-Adapter, our method achieves

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on both tasks. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: contributions of this work can be summarized as follows:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • First, we pioneer the analysis of the incompleteness of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the Segment Anything (SAM) model as a foundation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model and propose a research problem of how to uti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lize the SAM model to serve downstream tasks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • Second, we are the first to propose the adaptation ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: proach, SAM-Adapter, to adapt SAM to downstream

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tasks and achieve enhanced performance. The adapter

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: integrates the task-specific knowledge with general

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: knowledge learnt by the large model. The task-specific

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: knowledge can be flexibly designed.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • Third, despite SAM's backbone being a simple plain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model lacking specialized structures tailored for the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two specific downstream tasks, our approach still sur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: passes existing methods and attains state-of-the-art

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (SOTA) performance in these downstream tasks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To the best of our knowledge, this work pioneers to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: demonstrate the exceptional ability of SAM to transfer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to other specific data domains with remarkable accuracy.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: While we only tested it on a few datasets, we expect SAM-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Adapter can serve as an effective and adaptable tool for var-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ious downstream segmentation tasks in different fields, in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cluding medical and agriculture. Within two weeks of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM model's release, we made our SAM-Adapter's train-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing and evaluation code, along with its checkpoints, pub-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: licly available, which has already been a valuable resource

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for many researchers in the community to experiment with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and build upon.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Semantic Segmentation. In recent years, semantic seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentation has made significant progress, primarily due

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to the remarkable advancements in deep-learning-based

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods such as fully convolutional networks (FCN)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [35], encoder-decoder structures [41, 50, 14, 1, 29],

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dilated convolutions [3, 4, 5, 6, 34], pyramid structures

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [60, 5, 52, 6, 57], attention modules [51, 16, 62], and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: transformers [54, 48, 45, 8]. Building upon previous

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: research, Segment Anything (SAM) [24] introduces a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: large ViT-based model trained on a large visual corpus.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This work aims to leverage the SAM to solve specific

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: downstream image segmentation tasks.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Adapters. The concept of Adapters was first introduced

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in the NLP community [19] as a tool to fine-tune a large

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pre-trained model for each downstream task with a com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pact and scalable model. In [44], multi-task learning was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: explored with a single BERT model shared among a few

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: task-specific parameters. In the computer vision commu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: nity, [30] suggested fine-tuning the ViT [11] for object de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tection with minimal modifications. Recently, ViT-Adapter

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [7] leveraged Adapters to enable a plain ViT to perform var-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ious downstream tasks. [33] introduce an Explicit Visual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Prompting (EVP) technique that can incorporate explicit vi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sual cues to the Adapter. However, no prior work has tried

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to apply Adapters to leverage pretrained image segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion model SAM trained at large image corpus. Here, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mitigate the research gap.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Camouflaged Object Detection (COD). Camouflaged ob-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ject detection, or concealed object detection is a challenging

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: but useful task that identifies objects blend in with their sur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: roundings. COD has wide applications in medicine, agri-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: culture, and art. Initially, researches of camouflage detec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion relied on low-level features like texture, brightness, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: color [15, 40, 18, 42] to distinguish foreground from back-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ground. It is worth noting that some of these prior knowl-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: edge is critical in identifying the objects, and is used to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: guide the neural network in this paper.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Le et al.[27] first proposed an end-to-end network con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sisting of a classification and a segmentation branch. Re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cent advances in deep learning-based methods have shown

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a superior ability to detect complex camouflaged objects

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [12, 37, 31]. In this work, we leverage the advanced neu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ral network backbone (a foundation model – SAM) with the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: input of task-specific prior knowledge to achieve the state-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of-the-art (SOTA) performance.

layout_dets.text: Shadow Detection. Shadows can occur when an object sur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: face is not directly exposed to light. They offer hints on light

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: source direction and scene illumination that can aid scene

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: comprehension [23, 25]. They can also negatively impact

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the performance of computer vision tasks [39, 9]. Early

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method use hand-crafted heuristic cues like chromacity, in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tensity and texture [21, 25, 56]. Deep learning approaches

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: leverage the knowledge learnt from data and use delicately

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: designed neural network structure to capture the informa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion (e.g. learned attention modules) [26, 10, 58]. This work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: leverage the heuristic priors with large neural network mod-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: els to achieve the state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3. Method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1. Using SAM as the Backbone

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: As previously illustrated, the goal of the SAM-Adapter

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is to leverage the knowledge learned from the SAM. There-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fore, we use SAM as the backbone of the segmentation net-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work. The image encoder of SAM is a ViT-H/16 model

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with 14x14 windowed attention and four equally-spaced

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: global attention blocks. We keep the weight of pretrained

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image encoder frozen. We also leverage the mask decoder

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the SAM, which consists of a modified transformer de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coder block followed by a dynamic mask prediction head.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We use the pretrained SAM's weight to initialize the weight

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the mask decoder of our approach and tune the mask de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: coder during training. We input no prompts into the original

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mask decoder of SAM.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Next, the task-specific knowledge

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is learned and in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: jected into the network via Adapters. We employ the con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cept of prompting, which utilizes the fact that foundation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: models have been trained on large-scale datasets. Using ap-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: propriate prompts to introduce task-specific knowledge [33]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can enhance the model's generalization ability on down-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stream tasks, especially when annotated data is scarce.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.2. Adapters

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The architecture of the proposed SAM-Adapter is illus-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trated in Figure 1. We aim to keep the design of the adapter

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to be simple and efficient. Therefore, we choose to use an

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adapter that consists of only two MLPs and an activate func-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion within two MLPs [33]. Specifically, the adapter takes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the information

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and obtains the prompt

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are linear layers used to generate task-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: specific prompts for each Adapter.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is an up-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: projection layer shared across all Adapters that adjusts the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dimensions of transformer features.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: refers to the output

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompt that is attached to each transformer layer of SAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: model. GELU is the GELU activation function [17]. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: information

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can be chosen to be in various forms.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.3. Input Task-Specific Information

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: It is worth noting that the information

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: can be in vari-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ous forms depending on the task and flexibly designed. For

layout_dets.text: 5. Conclusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this work, we first extend the Segment Anything

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (SAM) model and apply it to some downstream tasks. Our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: experiments reveal that, like other foundational models,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM is not effective in some vision tasks, for example,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dealing with concealed objects. Therefore, we propose the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SAM-Adapter, which utilizes SAM as the backbone and in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: jects customized information into the network through sim-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ple yet effective Adapters to enhance performance in spe-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cific tasks. We evaluate our approach in camouflaged object

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: detection and shadow detection tasks and demonstrate that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the SAM-Adapter not only significantly improves SAM's

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance but also achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sults. We anticipate that this work will pave the way for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: applying SAM in downstream tasks and will have signifi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cant impacts in various image segmentation and computer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: vision fields.
